verification.precondition: SurveyFrame paragraph, string-list, given-record, and term-record values contain well-formed astral Unicode exactly at their declared code-point maxima.
verification.stimulus: Round-trip the values through the canonical K11 text-form validator and then construct the SurveyFrame product group from those normalized values.
verification.expectedSemanticState: The form and Survey builder admit the same values and preserve every Unicode scalar exactly in the ContextFrame and Survey products.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The normalized field map and resulting record payloads remain byte-stable and semantically identical.
verification.forbiddenMutation: The Survey builder must not reinterpret JSON Schema or text-form code-point limits as UTF-16 code-unit limits, normalize Unicode, truncate data, or reject form-valid values.

behavior: SurveyFrame products preserve form-valid astral Unicode at every paragraph list and record length boundary
